Operating format

A working room for leaders setting the AI agenda for the year.

The session gives executives a January planning room to align the decisions, metrics, forums, and priorities that should guide AI work through 2027.

The room

Where the year starts with executive clarity.

The discussion asks what must be true by the end of Q1: who owns AI, what gets funded, what risks are governed, which workforce moves matter, and what the summit season should help leaders answer.

Audience
CEOs, CIOs, COOs, CFOs, CHROs, CISOs, strategy leaders, transformation leaders, and AI program owners setting 2027 priorities.
Access
Invitation-only, capped at nine executive participants for a moderated exchange rather than broadcast attendance.
Outcome
A clearer 2027 executive AI agenda and practical signal for MOJO AI Summits programming.
Moderated questions

The January questions that set the executive AI agenda for 2027.

Each question is designed to turn the expanded virtual series into operating priorities for the new year.

01

What are the top AI decisions for Q1?

Which governance, funding, staffing, vendor, workflow, and risk decisions need executive attention immediately?

02

Who owns the 2027 AI agenda?

What role should the CEO, CIO, COO, CFO, CHRO, CISO, business units, and AI councils each play?

03

Which use cases should define the year?

What work should become the visible proof points for value, adoption, efficiency, growth, trust, or customer experience?

04

What budget commitments are already clear?

Which investments need funding now, which need better evidence, and which should wait?

05

What governance must be operating by midyear?

Which policies, review forums, risk controls, disclosure norms, and accountability structures can no longer remain informal?

06

What workforce moves need executive sponsorship?

Which training, manager enablement, role design, communication, and culture decisions need visible leadership support?

07

How will leaders measure progress through 2027?

What metrics, executive reviews, dashboards, stories, and board updates should prove that AI is becoming a capability?

08

What should MOJO AI Summits help the market answer?

Which unresolved executive questions should shape 2027 briefs, virtual councils, sponsor conversations, speakers, and live summit tracks?
